speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help you, I need to know how old you are in hours or days and whether you were born via a normal vaginal delivery or a Cesarean section.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity.

Based on your history of being born at 33 weeks with respiratory distress two hours after birth, I suspect a surfactant deficiency. Can you tell me if the baby's chest movements are symmetrical or if there is any cyanosis?
